mapper.select: select psk_name from t_pos_skill where psk_position_id = #{positionId} and psk_required = 1 order by psk_id

select distinct t.tal_id as talentId, t.tal_status as status, r.rbs_id as resumeId, r.rbs_file_path as fileReference, r.rbs_user_id as resumeUserId, date_format(r.rbs_updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as resumeVersion from t_process_instance p join t_tal t on t.tal_id = p.pin_candidate_id left join t_res_base r on r.rbs_id = t.tal_resume_id and r.rbs_user_id = t.tal_user_id where t.tal_company_id = (select pos_company_id from t_pos where pos_id = #{positionId}) and p.pin_position_id = #{positionId} order by t.tal_id
select skl_name from t_res_skill where skl_resume_id = (select tal_resume_id from t_tal where tal_id = #{talId}) order by skl_level desc, skl_id

select p.pin_position_id as taskId, pos.pos_title as positionName, count(distinct t.tal_id) as candidateCount, sum(case when t.tal_status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as passedCount from t_process_instance p join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = p.pin_position_id left join t_tal t on t.tal_id = p.pin_candidate_id where pos.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and t.tal_company_id = #{companyId} group by p.pin_position_id, pos.pos_title order by p.pin_position_id desc

select distinct t.tal_id as resultId, t.tal_matched_score as totalScore, t.tal_status as status, u.nick_name as name, u.phonenumber as phone, (select group_concat(skl_name separator ',') from t_res_skill s where s.skl_resume_id = t.tal_resume_id) as skills, (select group_concat(tg_name separator ',') from t_tal_tag g where g.tg_candidate_id = t.tal_id) as tags from t_process_instance p join t_tal t on t.tal_id = p.pin_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join t_res_base r on r.rbs_id = t.tal_resume_id and r.rbs_user_id = t.tal_user_id where t.tal_company_id = (select pos_company_id from t_pos where pos_id = #{positionId}) and p.pin_position_id = #{positionId} order by t.tal_matched_score desc, t.tal_id

select cast(grt_match_points as char) as matchPoints, grt_content as content, grt_status as status, grt_sent_at as sentAt from t_greeting_record where grt_candidate_id = #{talId} order by grt_id desc limit 1
select tal_id as talentId from t_tal where tal_id = #{talId} and tal_company_id = #{companyId}

select edu_major as major, case edu_degree when 1 then '中专' when 2 then '大专' when 3 then '本科' when 4 then '硕士' when 5 then '博士' else '未提供' end as degree, edu_description as description, cast(edu_start_date as char) as startDate, cast(edu_end_date as char) as endDate from t_res_education where edu_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by edu_id

select wrk_position as position, wrk_description as description, cast(wrk_start_date as char) as startDate, cast(wrk_end_date as char) as endDate, wrk_is_current as isCurrent from t_res_work where wrk_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by wrk_id

select prj_name as name, prj_role as role, prj_description as description, prj_tech_stack as techStack, cast(prj_start_date as char) as startDate, cast(prj_end_date as char) as endDate from t_res_project where prj_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by prj_id

select asr_candidate_id as candidateId, json_unquote(json_extract(asr_report, '$.resumeVersion')) as resumeVersion, json_unquote(json_extract(asr_report, '$.positionVersion')) as positionVersion from t_ai_candidate_analysis where asr_company_id = #{companyId} and asr_position_id = #{positionId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_ai_candidate_analysis (asr_company_id, asr_position_id, asr_candidate_id, asr_resume_id, asr_report) values (#{companyId}, #{positionId}, #{resultId}, #{resumeId}, #{report}) on duplicate key update asr_resume_id = values(asr_resume_id), asr_report = values(asr_report), asr_updated_at = now()
insert ignore into t_ai_screening_task (ast_company_id, ast_position_id, ast_run_id, ast_state) values (#{companyId}, #{positionId}, '', 'idle')
mapper.update: update t_ai_screening_task set ast_run_id = #{runId}, ast_state = 'processing', ast_candidate_count = #{candidateCount}, ast_completed_count = 0, ast_passed_count = 0, ast_error = null, ast_updated_at = now() where ast_company_id = #{companyId} and ast_position_id = #{positionId} and (ast_state != 'processing' or ast_updated_at < date_sub(now(), interval 15 minute))
mapper.sql: ast_position_id as taskId, ast_run_id as runId, ast_state as state, ast_candidate_count as candidateCount, ast_completed_count as completedCount, ast_passed_count as passedCount, ast_error as error, date_format(ast_updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt, case when ast_state = 'processing' then 1 else 0 end as processing
mapper.select: select from t_ai_screening_task where ast_company_id = #{companyId} and ast_position_id = #{positionId}
select from t_ai_screening_task where ast_company_id = #{companyId} and ast_position_id = #{positionId} for update
select a.app_id as applicationId, a.app_candidate_id as talentId from t_app_record a where a.app_position_id = #{positionId} and a.app_status = 0 order by a.app_id
select distinct a.app_position_id from t_app_record a join t_pos p on p.pos_id = a.app_position_id where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and a.app_status = 0 order by a.app_position_id
